mapper.select: SELECT MAX(order_no) FROM order_master WHERE order_no LIKE CONCAT(#{orderNoPrefix}, '%')

SELECT om.id, om.order_no AS orderNo, om.customer_id AS customerId, c.name AS customerName, c.phone AS customerPhone, om.order_type AS orderType, om.status, om.total_qty AS totalQty, om.total_amount AS totalAmount, om.is_draft AS isDraft, om.is_ar AS isAr, om.allow_replace AS allowReplace, om.remark, DATE_FORMAT(om.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM order_master om LEFT JOIN customer c ON om.customer_id = c.id WHERE om.id = #{id}
